title: Remove Launch UI helper flat aliases
summary: Removed seven Launch UI/settings/sample helper aliases from the transitional flat window surface while preserving app, command, and browser-readiness hooks.
reason: Continue namespace-first WebView cleanup in a Launch-owned touched domain without changing backend mutation, media policy, source handling, or pending-publish behavior.
behavior_before: Launch mode/single-file UI helpers, settings trust helpers, and sample-set coverage text helper were available both through window.mediaPipelineLaunchView and direct flat window aliases.
behavior_after: Those seven helpers are asserted through window.mediaPipelineLaunchView only. App startup, command history, start/rerun, and browser-readiness flat hooks remain exported.
tests_added: Extended Local API WebView static coverage to assert namespace availability and absence of the removed Launch UI/settings/sample helper flat aliases.
rollback_plan: Restore the seven Launch flat assignments, restore the inventory/current-state counts to 681 and launchView.js to 33, regenerate the WebView contract baseline and summaries, then rerun the same WebView validation ladder.
